page.description: openmediavault editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A Debian-based network-attached-storage system: a small installer that turns a PC into a file server with a web interface for shares, RAID, users and services.
pros: Turns ordinary x86-64 hardware into a NAS.
Web interface for shares, disks, RAID and users.
Debian 13 underneath, with APT for extra packages.
Plugin model keeps the base small.
cons: Not a desktop: it is administered from the browser.
AMD64 ISO installer only; ARM boards use a Debian base image.
The installer ISO and the installed package versions differ.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for openmediavault; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the AMD64 ISO to a USB stick and install it on the machine that should become the NAS. Writing erases the stick; the installer erases the target disk.
